page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-16 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance belonging to the c4n server family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 124.0 GB of RAM, establishing a high memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource sharing.

The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be handled via network-attached block storage. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This configuration is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require dedicated CPU resources but do not demand local physical disks or graphics acceleration. It is suitable for database caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
